top_signals.title: India's Dixon Tech Eyes Growth Beyond Smartphones
top_signals.summary: Sunil Vachani , the Executive Chairman of Dixon Technologies expects the company's EMS rankings to be in the top 5 in the next decade. In an exclusive conversation with BTV's Menaka Doshi, he adds that the company is eyeing growth beyond smartphones to add global clout. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
